A firm’s relationship summary tells you about:
the types of services a firm offers; ... manages some accounts (called discretionary accounts) by making trades for you.
answer: A client relationship summary (Form CRS) can help you understand what services a firm offers. For discretionary investment management, an adviser manages some accounts by making trades for you. Review the summary to see whether this type of service is offered, and remember that the services you receive depend on your agreement with the adviser.
